data.summary: “Steph was crine🥀” has pulled 24,233,179 views at ~21,228/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a POV/skit whose strongest lever is curiosity gap. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.
An unusually high like-to-view ratio suggests strong resonance, a signal the algorithm likely reads as a reason to keep distributing it.
